applicability.basis: The modeled record is limited to the evidence window beginning with the exact Sentinel-1C Level-1 product day used by the TAT-C reference and ending at the 2026-10-30 source-check cutoff (exclusive at the next UTC day). This is an evidence boundary, not a claimed mission end date or acquisition schedule. Earlier and later dates are not established by this registry revision.

attitude.roll_assumption: Use the measured IW median roll of 33.76 degrees, rounded to 33.8 degrees and signed negative for TAT-C right-looking geometry. This fixed profile does not represent orbit-dependent roll steering; the source reports roll/look-angle variation up to about 2.5 degrees.
attitude.pitch_assumption: Zero pitch is the explicit TAT-C mapping assumption; the cited Sentinel-1C geometry reference does not provide a pitch telemetry profile.

evidence.title: Side-Looking SAR Validation: Sentinel-1C
evidence.document_revision: TAT-C 3.6.0 validation notebook; product analysis day 2026-10-02
evidence.excerpt: For Sentinel-1C products on 2026-10-02, all 402 IW products are right-looking; IW median near/far geodetic look angles are 27.13/40.39 degrees, incidence angles 30.41/45.98 degrees, roll 33.76 degrees, and cross-track field of view 13.26 degrees. Zero-Doppler geometry matches Earth-fixed velocity within 0.00150 degrees. Look angles vary smoothly by up to about 2.5 degrees over the orbit. Fixed-roll Test 6 uses 2,990 edge comparisons and reports near/far cross-track p95 residuals 14.29/20.58 km and maxima 23.83/37.04 km. Fixed-roll IW footprint IoU is median 0.925 and fifth percentile 0.865 over 402 products. Earth-fixed observation-time test reports 750 points, zero missed, absolute p95 0.439 s, maximum 0.495 s. The notebook's along-track field of view is tailored to a roughly 5-second footprint step; that value is not the 0.23-degree physical antenna beam width mapped by this configuration.
evidence.interpretation: This is the spacecraft-specific reference data and TAT-C mapping context. It reports mission-product comparisons but does not validate this repository's exact adapter or prove any acquisition schedule.

evidence.authority: European Space Agency / Copernicus Sentinel-1 Mission
evidence.title: Sentinel-1 Product Definition
evidence.excerpt: C-SAR operates at 5.405 GHz, looks right, and has a 0.23-degree azimuth antenna beam width. IW has at least 250 km ground swath, three TOPSAR subswaths and azimuth steering of plus or minus 0.6 degrees. The product gives separate off-nadir and incidence ranges for IW1/IW2/IW3 at reference altitudes near 698 km and 726 km. The attitude section specifies zero-Doppler orientation and roll steering around a 711.7 km reference altitude.
evidence.interpretation: Use the measured Sentinel-1C IW look and incidence summary for the fixed-view envelope, retain all six altitude/subswath ranges separately, and use the physical azimuth antenna beam width only as the TAT-C along-track field-of-view approximation. It is not a SAR integration or burst-duration model.

interpretation.summary: Sentinel-1C C-SAR IW is a right-looking, zero-Doppler side-looking mode. Map the measured median 33.76-degree geodetic look direction and 13.26-degree cross-track field to a fixed rectangular PointedInstrument in TAT-C's Earth-fixed velocity frame. Preserve incidence angles as ground-normal angles, separate from spacecraft off-nadir look angles.
limitations: This fixed median view is an accepted approximation to orbit-dependent roll steering and three electronic TOPSAR subswaths; it does not model steering, subswath transitions, bursts, gaps, or acquisition plans.
The 0.23-degree antenna azimuth beam width is used as the TAT-C along-track angular view. It does not model synthetic-aperture integration, burst timing, azimuth steering, or SAR image formation.
The published TAT-C product residuals use a different along-track field chosen for approximately five-second footprint sampling. They are context only and do not validate this exact mapping.
The fixed evidence interval is not spacecraft lifetime or proof of acquisition availability.
Zero pitch is a TAT-C model assumption, not a sourced spacecraft telemetry value.

approximations.description: A fixed roll of -33.8 degrees and a 13.3-degree rectangular cross-track view approximate the median Sentinel-1C IW geometry. The source reports orbit-dependent roll/look variation up to about 2.5 degrees; the fixed-roll TAT-C reference has 14.29 km near-edge and 20.58 km far-edge cross-track p95 residuals.
approximations.impact: Access opportunities can miss or add points near the real swath edges, especially where roll steering moves the swath. This geometry does not confirm a real IW acquisition.

approximations.description: One continuous rectangular view spans three electronic TOPSAR IW subswaths and the source's 1-degree field-of-regard guard. It does not model per-subswath pointing, burst timing, inter-subswath gaps, or the selected product plan.
approximations.impact: The envelope may count access through areas or times that an individual subswath or actual acquisition plan does not use.

approximations.description: The 0.23-degree physical azimuth antenna beam width is supplied as TAT-C's along-track field of view.
approximations.impact: This is not SAR synthetic-aperture integration time, an image-line duration, burst length, or a continuous viewing interval.

mission_reference_checks.comparison_target: Sentinel-1C Level-1 GRD product annotations from 2026-10-02, compared with TAT-C's published fixed-roll IW references
mission_reference_checks.tolerance_basis: For fixed-roll edge errors and maxima, limits are rounded upward to the next whole kilometre above the published p95/max. Footprint tolerances equal the published rounded quantiles. Time limits equal the published three-decimal p95/max; the limit is not an application-specific validation threshold. These record the external TAT-C reference performance and its limitations, not an acceptance claim for this mapping.
mission_reference_checks.limitation: This published comparison does not validate the repository's exact access adapter or acquisition capability. The notebook uses an along-track field of view tailored to approximately five-second footprint sampling, while this registry configuration uses the sourced 0.23-degree physical azimuth antenna beam width; the fixed roll also does not follow measured orbit-dependent roll steering. Keep its residuals as reference context only.

geometry_checks.description: Published fixed-roll IW near-range cross-track edge residual.
geometry_checks.method: TAT-C 3.6.0 Sentinel-1C validation Test 6 against odd-numbered product annotations.
geometry_checks.tolerance_basis: Round the published 14.29 km p95 upward to 15 km, allowing less than 5 percent margin for a limited fixed-view approximation.
geometry_checks.limitation: The fixed median roll residual is dominated by orbit-dependent steering and does not validate this exact access mapping.

geometry_checks.description: Published fixed-roll IW far-range cross-track edge residual.
geometry_checks.method: TAT-C 3.6.0 Sentinel-1C validation Test 6 against odd-numbered product annotations.
geometry_checks.tolerance_basis: Round the published 20.58 km p95 upward to 21 km, a 0.42 km tolerance margin.
geometry_checks.limitation: The source's roll profile reduces the far-edge p95 to 7.02 km; the fixed approximation retains the larger reported residual.

geometry_checks.description: Fifth-percentile intersection-over-union of fixed-roll predicted IW product frames and Sentinel-1C annotation footprints.
geometry_checks.method: TAT-C 3.6.0 Sentinel-1C validation Test 4, IW subset of 402 product footprints.
geometry_checks.tolerance_basis: Use the published rounded fifth percentile as the reference floor, with no additional margin.
geometry_checks.limitation: The notebook's along-track field of view differs from this mapping; this statistic is reference context, not a local adapter test.

geometry_checks.description: Published absolute p95 event-epoch residual against Sentinel-1C zero-Doppler point truth.
geometry_checks.method: TAT-C 3.6.0 Sentinel-1C validation Test 5: 750 interior points from every tenth product, Earth-fixed frame.
geometry_checks.tolerance_basis: Round the published 0.439 s p95 upward to the nearest half-second; this is a reference threshold, not an app accuracy claim.
geometry_checks.limitation: The source uses its approximately five-second along-track sampling approximation and does not validate this exact adapter.
